about: BabyGearRecs catalog (2026-11-01, approved by the owner): strollers, car seats, baby carriers and wraps, high chairs, cribs/bassinets/play yards, baby monitors, breast pumps and bottles, bouncers and swings. Each exact name and URL was read on the maker's own site or store. Generations are separate products (Vista V2 vs V3, Doona vs Doona X, PIPA rx vs PIPA aire rx); fabric, colour and retailer editions are folded into the base product; older generations are in only where the maker's site still names them (UPPAbaby's manuals page). Columns: shape = category; core (child limits), weight, surface (folded size) and balance (notable features) not read. Blank = not read.
